sloka: इत्युक्त्वा पाणिना शैलमालभ्य हरिपुङ्गवः ।जगामाकाशमाविश्य वीर्यवान् प्रहसन्निव ॥५-१-१३३॥
transliteration: ityuktvā pāṇinā śailamālabhya haripuṅgavaḥ ।jagāmākāśamāviśya vīryavān prahasanniva ॥5-1-133॥

translations.english: Having said this, the mighty monkey gently touched the mountain with his hands before ascending to the sky with a smile on his face.
